text: # Incident Report: 4G Cell Cluster Outage **Document ID:** INC_C08_INC_2026_0142 **Category:** C08 — Network Coverage & Outages **Department:** Network **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-06-13 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Summary Fibre backhaul cut near Andheri due to third-party roadworks caused a 3-hour outage affecting ~40 4G sites. ## Detection Method Detected automatically via NOC monitoring alarms, which triggered an on-call page within the standard 5-minute alerting SLA. ## Timeline 06:12 IST fault detected via NOC alarms; 06:20 field team dispatched; 08:40 temporary microwave backhaul restored; 09:15 fibre repaired and primary path restored. | Time | Event | Observation | Action | |---|---|---|---| | T+0 | Fault detected | Alarm/ticket volume triggers investigation | On-call engineer paged | | T+10m | Initial triage | Affected scope estimated | Field/remote team engaged as needed | | T+Xh | Interim mitigation | Partial service restored where possible | Status page updated | | T+Yh | Full restoration | Service confirmed normal | Incident closed, RCA initiated if required | ## Customer Impact Estimated customers affected and service categories impacted are recorded in the internal incident-management system (ref: INC-2026-0142). Customer-facing status was published under Network > Service Status for the outage duration. ## Initial Hypothesis The initial working theory pointed to the most probable cause based on alarm signatures and affected-scope pattern; this was confirmed or revised during investigation. ## Investigation The response team correlated alarm data, affected-site/customer patterns, and any recent change or third-party activity in the area
title: 4G Cell Cluster Outage
